observations: The page number «VIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.

L17 and L20 «Al-Ma’mūns» and L32 «fī’l-djebr wa’l-muḳābala»: the hamza and the elided article are printed as an apostrophe, ’. L21 and N03 «Muh.» are printed without a dot under the h, where L16 has «Muḥammed». N01: the mark over the u of the first «Abū» is printed thin and broken, so that it looks curved; read as the macron of «Abū ʿAbdallāh» in the same line. L22-L23 and L23: the German quotation marks, „ and “.
L31: dark specks after the point of «B.», above and below the line; not transcribed. Spaced type and italics as marked; L16 «1.» numbers the first biography, in the type of the text.
